page.overview:
Who is Longslide?

Longslide is a member of Action Force who looks very like Footloose, well one version of him.

Longslide was the new "bulletstopper" for the American branch of Action Force, based at Fort Wadsworth. Upon arrival he was taken on a mission by Wild Bill to pick up equipment and he joined Flint in taking on Tomax and Xamot at a funfair.

Footloose rarely appeared in subsequent US stories that were reprinted in the UK but when he did appear his name was not changed.

Category:Comics only characters Category:Action Force members Category:A Real American Hero characters
